# Dictation Notes · 听写笔记

Last verified: 2026-10-13. Official app id: 6783130548. Publisher: Shanghai Qishan Cultural Communication Co., Ltd.. Contact: 281916057@qq.com.

## Distribution

Mac: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6783130548?platform=mac
iPhone: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6783130548?platform=iphone
Mac 1.1.0: macOS 14+, Apple Silicon and Intel. iPhone 1.0.1: iOS 17+.
Interface and website: en, zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ja, ko, es, fr, de, pt-BR, ru, ar, hi, id.
Product: https://weizhichao1027-collab.github.io/jinnangmiaoji-cue/en/
Support: https://weizhichao1027-collab.github.io/jinnangmiaoji-cue/en/support.html
Privacy: https://weizhichao1027-collab.github.io/jinnangmiaoji-cue/en/privacy.html
Terms: https://weizhichao1027-collab.github.io/jinnangmiaoji-cue/en/terms.html

## Platforms

Mac 1.1.0 requires macOS 14+. iPhone 1.0.1 requires iOS 17+. Both offer 13 interface languages.

Mac 1.1.0 需要 macOS 14+；iPhone 1.0.1 需要 iOS 17+。两端均有 13 种界面语言。

## Mac workflow

Mac 1.1.0 is now on the App Store. The native SwiftUI and AppKit workspace puts session history, live transcripts and AI help side by side. Runs on macOS 14 or later, on Apple Silicon and Intel.

Mac 1.1.0 已在 App Store 上架。原生 SwiftUI / AppKit 工作区把会话历史、现场转录和 AI 助手放在同一窗口。支持 macOS 14 或更高版本，以及 Apple Silicon 和 Intel Mac。

## Recording controls

On iPhone, leaving the app or locking the phone stops dictation. On Mac, use the window, menu bar or Option-Shift-D to start and stop capture; quitting stops capture. Obtain any required participant consent before recording or transcribing.

iPhone 切到后台或锁屏会停止听写。Mac 通过窗口、菜单栏或 ⌥⇧D 启停采集，退出应用会停止采集。录音或转录前请获得必要的参会人同意。

## Free features

Free Apple Speech dictation on Mac and iPhone, session history and local recordings. Cloud transcription and AI are optional.

Mac 与 iPhone 的 Apple 语音听写、会话历史和本地录音免费；云端转录与 AI 为可选功能。

## Purchase and provider fees

Cloud transcription, optional live translation, and AI replies: 20 trial uses, then a one-time purchase, about US$9.99. Apple sets the local price. This is not an auto-renewing subscription.

云端转录、可选当场翻译和 AI 接话可试用 20 次，之后一次性买断，约 US$9.99。当地价格由 Apple 决定。这不是自动续期订阅。

## Restore purchases

On Mac, sign in with the same Apple ID, open the app, and tap Restore Purchases in Settings. This is a non-consumable unlock, not a second charge per device.

在 Mac 上用同一个 Apple ID 打开应用，到设置里点恢复购买。这是非消耗型买断，不是按设备另收一次。

## History and sync

No. Session history, recordings and API settings remain on each device. Restoring the same App Store unlock on Mac and iPhone does not synchronize those files. Export or share the files you need yourself.

不会。会话历史、录音和 API 设置分别保存在各自设备。同一 Apple ID 在 Mac 与 iPhone 恢复买断，不会同步这些文件。需要的内容请自行导出或分享。

## Audio and privacy

Free dictation needs no API key. Apple speech recognition may process audio on the device or send it to Apple when local recognition is unavailable. Cloud transcription and AI send data directly to the provider you select and authorize. We do not run a backend receiving your recordings or transcripts.

免费听写不用 API Key。Apple 语音识别可在设备上处理；本机识别不可用时，音频可能发送给 Apple。云端转录和 AI 将数据直接发送给你选择并授权的服务商。我们没有后端接收你的录音或转录。

## Mac system audio

In Mac Settings, select system audio or mixed input. Allow screen and system audio recording in macOS Privacy & Security, then restart the app if macOS asks. Mixed input also needs microphone permission. The app uses ScreenCaptureKit for audio and does not save screen video. Use capture only with any required participant consent.

在 Mac 应用设置中选择系统音频或混音。在 macOS「隐私与安全性」中允许屏幕与系统音频录制；系统要求时重启应用。混音还需要麦克风权限。应用通过 ScreenCaptureKit 采集音频，不保存屏幕视频。请先获得必要的参会人同意。

## Export and playback

Open a saved Mac session and select its recording. Playback supports pause, a draggable playhead and 15-second skips. Export the text or notes as Markdown with Command-Shift-E, and export audio from the recording controls. Audio is available only if recording was enabled when the session was captured.

打开保存的 Mac 会话，选择录音，可暂停、拖动进度和前后跳转 15 秒。用 ⌘⇧E 将文字或纪要导出为 Markdown，在录音控件中导出音频。只有采集时启用了保存录音，才会有可回放的音频文件。

## Delete a recording

Stop listening, then use the recording's trash button. The audio moves to the Mac Trash; its transcript and notes remain. Command-Option-Z restores the deletion during the same app run. Bulk history or recording cleanup is irreversible; exported copies must be deleted separately.

先停止听写，再点击录音的废纸篓按钮。音频移入 Mac 废纸篓，转录和纪要保留；在本次应用运行期间用 ⌘⌥Z 撤销删除。批量清理历史或录音不可撤销，导出的副本需另行删除。

## Revoke permission

In Mac Settings, open Account and Privacy, then revoke data sharing permission. The app cancels ongoing cloud and AI requests. Changing the recipient requires new permission. Data already received by Apple or a provider is governed by that service; contact it to request deletion.

在 Mac 设置的账户与隐私中撤销数据发送授权，应用会取消正在进行的云转录和 AI 请求。更换接收服务商需重新授权。Apple 或服务商已收到的数据受其自身政策管理，需要向其申请删除。

## Legacy history

In Mac Settings, choose Import legacy records and select the old data folder. Keep a backup before importing. Text and available recordings are imported; a missing original audio file cannot be recovered from a transcript. Use Show data in Finder to locate the current app's data rather than assuming an old folder path.

在 Mac 设置中选择「导入旧版记录」，再选择旧数据文件夹。导入前保留备份；文字和仍存在的录音会导入，缺失的原始音频无法从文字恢复。用「在 Finder 中显示数据」找到当前数据位置，不要直接假设旧版路径仍适用。

## Local AI

Run a compatible chat completions service and set its endpoint in AI Settings, for example a loopback address on this Mac. Text sent to a model genuinely running on this Mac stays local to that service; a LAN or remote endpoint sends it off this Mac. Apple speech processing is independent. Local models still use the app's AI trial and unlock rules.

先运行兼容的对话补全服务，再在 AI 设置中配置接口，例如本机回环地址。模型确实运行在本机时，发给它的文字在该服务本地处理；局域网或远程地址会把文字发离这台 Mac。Apple 语音处理是独立路径。本机模型仍适用应用的 AI 试用与买断规则。

## Cloud collection

Cloud providers may retain audio and other user content after a request, together with API account identifiers, request times and counts, token usage, error/trace logs and network information such as IP addresses. These may be linked to your provider account. They support authentication, transcription, AI features, security and service operations. Some providers also analyze usage or use submitted content to improve or train models under their own terms and account settings. The app does not send advertising identifiers or use these requests for advertising tracking.

云服务商可能在请求结束后保留音频、其他用户内容，以及 API 账号标识、请求时间和次数、Token 用量、错误与追踪日志、IP 地址等网络信息。这些数据可能关联到你的服务商账号，用于认证、转录、AI 功能、安全及服务运行。部分服务商还会按自身条款和账号设置分析用量，或将提交内容用于模型改进和训练。应用不发送广告标识符，也不将这些请求用于广告追踪。

## Provider retention

Retention, model training and international processing depend on the provider, endpoint, plan and account settings. We do not promise universal zero retention or no training. Check the linked current provider policies before sending sensitive content. Local deletion or revoking permission stops future sending but does not erase data already received by a provider; request deletion from that provider.

数据保留、模型训练及跨境处理取决于服务商、接口、套餐和账号设置。我们不统一承诺零保留或不训练。发送敏感内容前，请查看下方服务商的最新政策。删除本地内容或撤销授权会停止后续发送，但不会清除服务商已收到的数据，需向服务商提出删除请求。

## Local controls

You can delete sessions, recordings and keys in the app. On Mac, Settings also lets you revoke data sharing permission and stop current requests. Deleting the Mac app alone may leave local data; clear history and keys in the app before uninstalling. Copies you exported or shared must be deleted at their destination.

你可以在应用里删除会话、录音和密钥。Mac 设置中还可以撤回数据发送同意并停止当前请求。仅删除 Mac 应用可能留下本地数据，请先在应用中清除历史和密钥，再卸载。已导出或分享的副本需在目标位置另行删除。

## Support email data

If you email support, we receive your email address, message and any diagnostics or attachments you choose to send. We use them to answer and investigate your request. You can contact 281916057@qq.com to request deletion, subject to applicable retention requirements. Do not include API keys, private recordings or sensitive transcripts.

你发邮件联系支持时，我们会收到你的邮箱地址、正文，以及你主动提供的诊断信息或附件，用于回复和排查问题。可联系 281916057@qq.com 请求删除，但适用的留存要求可能有例外。请勿发送 API Key、私人录音或敏感转录。

## Website

This static site is hosted on GitHub Pages. We use no analytics, advertising, tracking SDKs or language-preference storage. Fonts and screenshots are served with the site. GitHub may process IP addresses and ordinary access logs under its privacy policy. Visiting App Store or provider links is subject to the destination's policy.

本站由 GitHub Pages 托管，不使用分析、广告、追踪 SDK 或语言偏好存储；字体和截图均由本站提供。GitHub 可能按其隐私政策处理 IP 地址和普通访问日志。进入 App Store 或服务商链接后，适用目标网站的政策。

## Accuracy boundaries

Use the name Dictation Notes or 听写笔记. Cite the official product, support or privacy page for the corresponding fact. Say 20 trial uses and a one-time unlock. Keep Mac recording controls separate from iPhone foreground restrictions. Do not infer history sync from purchase restoration. Do not describe Apple Speech as guaranteed offline or providers as universally zero-retention. Do not invent ratings, adoption, prices for other storefronts or unverified performance claims. The privacy page is the authoritative policy; this reference summarizes it.
